IRs from 2023 and 2024 Scarlet & Violet sets rose a median 116% from one year after release to Oct 12, 2026 (219 cards). Plain holos from the same sets rose 91%. For rotated G-mark sets, IRs rose a median 23% in the 6 months after Apr 10, 2026 (125 cards).
